peircean_analysis.firstness: svchost.exe PID 612: on-disk binary has valid Microsoft hash and is digitally signed (clean). In-memory .text section permissions: RWX (expected: RX). Parent process: cmd.exe PID 4412 (expected: services.exe). Outbound connection from svchost.exe to 52.85.0.0/16 (AWS CloudFront), port 443.
peircean_analysis.secondness: Two Windows structural invariants are simultaneously violated: (A) Legitimate svchost.exe is always spawned by services.exe — this is the Windows service control manager contract with no documented exception in any Windows version. A parent of cmd.exe for svchost.exe is not a misconfiguration; it is a physical impossibility in a legitimately operating system. (B) Legitimate .text sections are marked RX (read-execute). RWX (read-write-execute) on .text indicates the process image was written to in memory after loading — the canonical artifact of process hollowing. JIT compilation (the strongest benign explanation for RWX) occurs in heap or data segments, never in .text. The on-disk hash being clean confirms the memory-vs-disk split: disk = legitimate Microsoft binary, memory = replaced payload.
peircean_analysis.thirdness: Process hollowing (T1055.012): attacker created a suspended svchost.exe process, unmapped the legitimate binary from memory, wrote malicious shellcode into the vacated region (requiring RWX on .text), then resumed execution. The AWS CloudFront connection is deliberate CDN laundering: by routing C2 traffic through a CDN IP range, the attacker exploits analyst familiarity with CloudFront as a legitimate destination. This is Carnegie authority transfer — borrowing the legitimacy of AWS CDN infrastructure to suppress scrutiny of svchost.exe outbound traffic. The combination is INTENT: two independent structural impossibilities on the same process establish deliberate engineering, not coincidence.

refutation_protocol.benign_hypothesis: H2: Sysadmin debugging could disable memory protections. A management script could have launched svchost. CloudFront is used by Windows Update and telemetry.
refutation_protocol.test_result: H2 REFUTED: (A) JIT compilation never occurs in the .text section — RWX on .text has no legitimate software explanation in Windows, including debugging scenarios; debuggers do not require RWX on .text. (B) No Windows system management flow creates svchost.exe from cmd.exe — the Windows service control manager is the invariant parent with no exception in any documented Windows version or service pack. (C) Two simultaneous independent structural impossibilities on the same process cannot be explained by two independent legitimate causes without stacking implausible assumptions. H2 requires two unexplained simultaneous anomalies on the same process — Occam's razor rejects this.
refutation_protocol.refutation_outcome: H2 REFUTED on three independent prongs. INTENT confirmed.

devil_advocate: On-disk hash is clean and binary is digitally signed. The destination IP 52.85.0.0/16 belongs to AWS CloudFront, used by thousands of legitimate applications including Windows Update and telemetry. svchost.exe is expected to make network connections as a system service host. Without memory forensics visibility, the CDN connection alone would not trigger a finding. Counter: neither the CDN connection nor the signed binary can explain the RWX .text section or the cmd.exe parent — these require the hollowing assumption, and that assumption fully explains all three anomalies simultaneously.
